_help: The opening cutscenes' lines. Edit the text here; no code needed. speaker: eli, cole, nora or walter. id: the voice clip name (put road_01.ogg / .wav / .mp3 in assets/audio/voice/ and it plays with the line). shot: where the camera is (road: over_cole, eli, hands, windshield, cole_window, cole; meeting: the speaker's face). pause: seconds of silence before the line. action: something a character does on that line.

road.speaker: eli
road.text: You ever hear of a place called Blackwater?

road.speaker: eli
road.text: It's a weather station. Middle of nowhere. Mateo's last text came from a gas station twenty miles from it.

road.speaker: eli
road.text: He's not the only one. Eight people went missing out there since August. Marcus. Jenna. A reporter. Nobody looks for them. Nobody even asks.

road.speaker: cole
road.text: Some people don't want to be found.

road.speaker: eli
road.text: And some people don't get a choice.

road.speaker: cole
road.text: You've been thinking about this since the night he left.

road.speaker: eli
road.text: Since he walked up that road in his uniform jacket and didn't come back. He's my big brother, Cole. Six minutes older. He'd come for me.

road.speaker: cole
road.text: We're not doing this alone. We're meeting some people.

road.speaker: eli
road.text: People? You said it'd be just us.

road.speaker: cole
road.text: A reporter who's been chasing the same story. And a man who used to work there.

road.speaker: cole
road.text: I don't trust anybody. ...Except you, kid. Take the next left.

meeting.speaker: cole
meeting.text: We're here. Eli, this is Nora Vance. She's been chasing Blackwater for three years.

meeting.speaker: nora
meeting.text: I read about your brother. I'm sorry.

meeting.speaker: walter
meeting.text: I worked maintenance there. A long time ago. I know the tunnels. ...I didn't think I'd ever go back.

meeting.speaker: cole
meeting.text: Gear's in the trunk. Grab what you need. We go in before sunrise.
